ui_copy.ui.title: SIX MONTHS OF PROMISES
ui_copy.ui.subtitle: Choose what Minjun protects — and what he must let go.
ui_copy.ui.home.title: Six months. One promise you refuse to drop.
ui_copy.ui.home.body: Each month, choose one protected promise. With margin on the same axis, you may carry one more alongside it. Before choosing, you know only the action, deadline, and whether it can return once.
ui_copy.ui.home.restart_confirm: PRESS AGAIN TO ERASE THIS PLAYTEST SAVE
ui_copy.ui.home.autosave: Only this six-month playtest is saved. Retail and 24-week saves are never opened.
ui_copy.ui.month.prompt: What will you protect this month?
ui_copy.ui.month.known_information: Only the action, axis, deadline, and whether it can return are known in advance.
ui_copy.ui.month.margin.none: No margin carried · choose one protected promise
ui_copy.ui.month.margin.available: {axis} margin available · one {axis_lower} promise may be added
ui_copy.ui.detail.empty: Move focus to a promise to inspect it.
ui_copy.ui.detail.optional_same_card: The same promise cannot fill both roles.
ui_copy.ui.detail.optional_no_margin: No carried margin is available this month.
ui_copy.ui.detail.optional_spends: Adding it spends this month's {axis_lower} margin. It is not refunded.
ui_copy.ui.detail.single_margin: Keeping only this protected promise can create {axis_lower} margin next month.
ui_copy.ui.detail.repay_pressure: Keeping it repays pressure carried from last month. It creates no new margin.
ui_copy.ui.detail.repay_deferred: Keeping it repays a promise deferred from last month. It creates no new margin.
ui_copy.ui.detail.double_no_margin: Keeping two promises spends the carried margin and creates no new margin.
ui_copy.ui.detail.window.deferred: DEFER · If missed, it returns as a choice once next month.
ui_copy.ui.detail.window.expired: WINDOW · Once this month passes, this promise cannot be recovered.
ui_copy.ui.detail.unknown_outcome: What follows is revealed only when it actually happens.

ui_copy.ui.status.primary_set: Protected promise set. You may now inspect an eligible second promise.
ui_copy.ui.status.optional_set: Alongside promise set. The carried margin will be spent on confirmation.
ui_copy.ui.status.optional_removed: Alongside promise removed. The margin is still available until confirmation.
ui_copy.ui.status.primary_removed: Protected promise removed. Alongside was cleared with it.
ui_copy.ui.status.invalid: That role is not available for this promise.
ui_copy.ui.result.title: What you kept — and what moved on without you
ui_copy.ui.result.margin.run_complete: Six-month sample complete · {axis} margin is recorded, but there is no playable next month in this sample.
ui_copy.ui.result.deferred_status: It returns as a choice once next month.
ui_copy.ui.recap.title: Six months of choices
ui_copy.ui.recap.body: This is not a score. It is the route made by what you protected, what margin let you carry, and which doors you allowed to close.

M02.design_label: The Face of the First Choice

m01_survival_shift.label: Finish enough shifts to cover the first month's rent and food.

m01_legal_application.label: Submit the first legitimate application and finish preparing for the interview.

m01_father_call.label: Call Dad first and ask how he is this week.

m02_close_account_risk.label: Check and contain the account risk and cash gap left by the first illegal offer.

m02_hyunsu_first_promise.label: Show up for the first study promise made with Hyunsu and hold your place beside him.

m02_return_father_call.label: Call Dad back the same day after his short message.

m03_cover_deposit_gap.label: Confirm the deposit shortfall and remaining lodging days before notice to leave.

m03_daeun_return.label: Return to the convenience store at dawn and ask Daeun her name.

m03_jiyeon_answer.label: Answer Jiyeon's offer to compensate you after the bicycle accident.

m04_answer_job_result.label: Answer the hiring result and confirm the first day of work.

m04_independent_room_view.label: Visit one room you booked yourself and check the deposit and monthly rent.

m04_sangchul_office_coffee.label: Ask Sangchul the real room price in his office and stay until the coffee cools.

m05_job_result.label: Settle one next step for your current livelihood: start date, shift, or another application.

m05_jaehyuk_reunion.label: Keep the street-stall reunion with Jaehyuk where money is not discussed.

m05_second_crossing.label: Contact the person you protected in M03 and arrange a second meeting.

label_by_actor.daeun: Contact Daeun first and arrange a second meeting.
label_by_actor.jiyeon: Contact Jiyeon first and arrange a second meeting.

m06_work_deadline.label: Submit the hiring or livelihood deadline paperwork yourself before 6:30 p.m. Friday.

m06_sangchul_door.label: Check the field address from Sangchul's side and arrive there that same Friday.

m06_family_signal.label: Call Dad at the agreed time after the pharmacy-bag signal.

m06_person_date.label: Go on the Friday date with the same person recorded in the M05 promise.

label_by_actor.daeun: Go on the Friday date promised with Daeun in M05.
label_by_actor.jiyeon: Go on the Friday date promised with Jiyeon in M05.
